cause: GET /bff/jobs called JobReadPort.list_jobs_bff with neither page_size nor limit, so JobReadPort._fetch_source_records walked every source-ingest owner page up to _OWNER_MAX_PAGES (100 pages of 250; hosted holds 15,426 ingest runs across 62 pages, growing ~1,200 rows/day) just to render one 20-row BFF page. On hosted dev this took 10-18 s (stalling /management/jobs in the RC1 WP1.2 management crawl) and when one deep page timed out (e.g. page_token=12000), _fetch_source_records returned (False, records, False) and list_jobs_bff discarded all 12,000 rows already read, returning 53 jobs from other sources with source_ingestion=unreachable.

ports/job_read.py.bounded_limit: JobReadPort.list_jobs_bff accepts limit: Optional[int] = None (clamped to >= 1) and passes it to _fetch_source_records. For bounded_list sources (source_ingestion), _fetch_source_records requests page_size = min(max(limit - len(records), 1), _OWNER_PAGE_SIZE) per owner page and stops as soon as len(records) >= limit or next_page_token is empty, slicing records[:limit]. Because each bounded owner answers newest-first, the newest (offset + page_size) rows from each source are sufficient for an exact newest-first merge across sources for the requested BFF page.
ports/job_read.py.owner_total: _fetch_source_records extracts page_info.total (int >= 0) from bounded owner responses as owner_total. list_jobs_bff computes diagnostics['total'] as the sum of max(owner_total, len(source_jobs)) for bounded sources that report a total plus len(source_jobs) for unbounded sources.
ports/job_read.py.filters: status is normalized and passed to bounded owners via the status query parameter; job_type filters self.sources so only the matching owner is queried.
ports/job_read.py.partial_on_later_page_failure: If a bounded owner fails (ok=False) after at least one owner page was already read (len(records) > 0), _fetch_source_records returns (True, records, 'partial', owner_total) instead of discarding the read rows. list_jobs_bff keeps those rows in the merged result, includes the source in healthy_sources, and sets degraded_sources[spec.name] = 'partial'. If the first owner page fails (records is empty), it returns (False, [], '', None) and reports degraded_sources[spec.name] = 'unreachable' with no fabricated rows or totals.

jobs/router.py.bounded_page_read: GET /bff/jobs validates page_token upfront via page_slice([], page_token, page_size), computes offset = _page_offset(page_token), and calls read_store.list_jobs_bff with limit = offset + page_size and deadline_seconds = _jobs_list_deadline_seconds() (filtering kwargs via inspect.signature for backward compatibility with minimal test doubles).
jobs/router.py.total_and_next_page_token: Uses diagnostics['total'] (bounded owners' reported totals + unbounded sources' counted rows) when present and no post-read filter narrowed raw_jobs, computing next_page_token = str(offset + page_size) if offset + page_size < total else None.
jobs/router.py.deadline_seconds: _JOBS_LIST_DEADLINE_DEFAULT_SECONDS = 5.0 (configurable via PANTHEON_BFF_JOBS_LIST_DEADLINE_SECONDS, clamped to >= 0.1 s, and capped by remaining_management_read_budget() when a management read budget is active). Rationale: each owner GET is bounded by PANTHEON_BFF_SERVICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (2.0 s) and all configured job owners are queried concurrently in JobReadPort's ThreadPoolExecutor; BFF page 1 (offset 0, page_size 20) needs 1 owner page per bounded source (<= 2.0 s) and deep pages up to offset + page_size <= 500 need at most 2 sequential owner pages (<= 4.0 s), so a 5.0 s whole-list deadline comfortably accommodates one slow owner page plus a follow-up page while cutting off a stalled source as degraded_sources[source] = 'timeout' well within the BFF's own management read budget and the RC1 WP1.2 crawl per-page render timeout (replacing the 10-18 s full 62-page walk).

residual_findings.finding: source-ingest ingest runs (list_runs_page / ingest_runs) have no retention policy and grow by approximately 1,200 runs per day (15,426 runs across 62 pages on 2026-11-27). Bounding GET /bff/jobs removes the full-history scan from the BFF jobs page, but the underlying ingest run store in source-ingest still requires an owner retention bound under RC3.
